text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert: prod-us-east streaming p99 latency > 5s for 10m. Auto-page to oncall. metrics: svc=prompt-core env=prod region=us-east p95=1.2s p99=6.8s error-rate=0.8%

jordan_oncall: Acknowledging. Investigating now. Noting streaming stalls / tail growth. Paging eng-runtime and SRE.

lee_runtime: On it. I see a big spike in preproc CPU time around 4401234500. Prompts with JSON-mode and inlined tool schemas are slower. Querying logs...

lee_runtime: Query: `select avg(tokenize_ms), p95(tokenize_ms) from preproc where ts > 4401234400 and region='us-east'` -> avg=28ms (normal=6ms) p95=420ms p99=1200ms.

amanda_sre: Nice caught. Customer impact? Any request errors or just latency?

product-sam: Customer ops: three downstream customers reported slow streaming (timeouts at 5s) and 2 support tickets mentioned truncated responses. IDs: cust-0821, cust-0912, cust-1107. All hitting heavy tool-schema prompts.

jordan_oncall: Root-thread hypothesis: recent prompt-template change (inlined tool schemas into builder) + JSON-mode parsing = O(N^2) expansion for big tool payloads. That increases tokenization and template rendering CPU.

lee_runtime: Repro steps from my box (dev):
```bash
# simulate large tool-schema prompt
python tools/bench_prompt.py --json-mode --schema samples/huge_tool.json --iters 1000
# measure preproc times
```
Outputs show median preproc/tokenize time up 4x.

eng-bot-deploy: Deploy bot: note that a canary of PR #3124 (prompt-builder: inline-schema) landed to prod-us-east at 4401234405.

amanda_sre: Immediate mitigation options: 1) disable JSON-mode parsing at proxy for incoming streaming requests; 2) revert inline-schema canary; 3) add short-circuit parse to skip deep schema expansion for streaming routes. Which is fastest?

jordan_oncall: Prioritize minimal blast radius: toggle feature-flag `prompt_builder.inline_schema=false` for prod-us-east canary and enable `preproc.json_mode=false` at the edge for streaming route. I'll flip flags if agreed.

lee_runtime: I can rollback the canary in 60s, but toggle flags at the edge first. Edge toggle is config change:
```json
POST /admin/flags
{ "flag": "preproc.json_mode", "value": false, "scope": "region:us-east", "actor": "jordan_oncall" }
```

jordan_oncall: Executing edge toggle now.

jordan_oncall: `curl -XPOST https://ops.internal/flags -d '{"flag":"preproc.json_mode","value":false,"scope":"region:us-east"}'` -> 200.

amanda_sre: Observability: please watch p95/p99 and streaming-inflight counts. Also add a short-lived alert if tail queue > 200.

lee_runtime: Rolling back canary PR #3124 from prod-us-east (starting rollback). ETA 2m.

eng-bot-deploy: Rollback job queued, job-id=rb-4401234560.

jordan_oncall: After flag flip: p95=0.9s p99=1.4s observed in metrics (5m post-toggle). Streaming stall events dropped by ~87%. :thumbsup:

product-sam: Informing affected customers: sending a note that we applied mitigations and are investigating root cause. Asking for any lingering errors to be forwarded.

amanda_sre: Good. Next steps: assign root-cause owner for full investigation (inc. prompt-builder expansion complexity), instrument tokenization path to sample slow requests, and prepare a mitigation playbook for JSON-mode large-schema cases.

lee_runtime: I'll own the RCA and fix. Initial action items: 1) add complexity guard in prompt-builder to avoid deep inlining; 2) optimize tokenizer path for large JSON payloads; 3) add synthetic load tests for streaming+json-mode. Filing ticket now.

jordan_oncall: Handoff to lee_runtime for deep triage. I'll remain on call until handoff complete.

amanda_sre: Please capture timeline and customer impact for postmortem. Assign sev: SEV3 (SLO breach, partial customer impact, mitigated).

lee_runtime: Created ticket RW-INC-7891: "prompt-builder: JSON-mode schema inlining causes preproc tail latency". Linking logs and reproducer.

eng-bot-deploy: Deploy bot: rollback rb-4401234560 succeeded, canary removed at 4401234598.

jordan_oncall: Verified p99 back to normal band (~1.3s) and error-rate dropped. Closing live incident but keeping thread open for RCA updates.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (SEV3) - mitigation applied and verified. Follow-up ticket: https://redwood.internal/ops/tickets/RW-INC-7891. Postmortem due in 5 business days.

product-sam: Thx all — please add affected customer notes in RW-INC-7891 and coordinate communication with CS. :mag_right:

amanda_sre: Leaving a quick checklist for the RCA: reproducer, bench numbers (before/after), stack trace to tokenizer hotspots, and any config knobs we add.

lee_runtime: Will post first RCA draft in #eng-runtime and link here when ready.

jordan_oncall: Handing off to lee_runtime. Oncall clear. :white_check_mark:
